{{Top|leg}}
'''St. Elmo's fire''' was a phenomenon characterized by a bright light and was commonly observed in the rigging of ancient [[Boat/Legends|sailing ships]]. The degree of its luminescence was comparable to that of the [[Kaiburr crystal]].
